hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && node -e "process.exit(require('./package.json').scripts?.typecheck ? 0 : 1)" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; npm run typecheck --silent 1>&2 || exit 2
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && node -e "process.exit(require('./package.json').scripts?.test ? 0 : 1)" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; npm test --silent 1>&2 || exit 2
